description: This file provides asynchronous CRUD utility functions for a job portal backend, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM to interact with database models such as User, Job, Application, and Profile. It encapsulates functionalities like fetching, creating, and updating user profiles, jobs, and applications, designed to be used within FastAPI handlers.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_id(db: AsyncSession, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a User record from the database by user ID.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_username(db: AsyncSession, username: str)
methods.description: Fetches a User record from the database by username.

methods.name: List[User] list_users(db: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all User records.

methods.name: User create_user(db: AsyncSession, username: str, email: str, hashed_password: str, role: UserRoleEnum)
methods.description: Creates a new User record with specified credentials and role.

methods.name: List[Job] list_jobs(db: AsyncSession, location: Optional[str] = None, skill: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists jobs, with optional filters for location and skill.

methods.name: Optional[Job] get_job_by_id(db: AsyncSession, job_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a Job record by job ID.

methods.name: Job create_job(db: AsyncSession, title: str, description: str, location: str, company: str, posted_by: int, skills: List[str])
methods.description: Creates a new Job entry with associated skills.

methods.name: Application create_application(db: AsyncSession, user_id: int, job_id: int, resume_url: Optional[str], status: ApplicationStatusEnum = ApplicationStatusEnum.pending)
methods.description: Creates a new Application record for a user applying to a job.

methods.name: List[Application] list_applications(db: AsyncSession, job_id: Optional[int] = None, user_id: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Fetches applications filtered by job or user.

methods.name: Optional[Application] get_application_by_id(db: AsyncSession, app_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an Application record by its ID.

methods.name: Optional[Profile] get_profile_by_user_id(db: AsyncSession, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a Profile associated with a given user ID.

methods.name: Profile upsert_profile(db: AsyncSession, user_id: int, bio: Optional[str], resume_url: Optional[str], company_info: Optional[str])
methods.description: Creates or updates a Profile for a user.
